reviews.title: Uhhh..... Missing content?
reviews.text: I got this under the impression it was an actual Pokémon quiz app. Because it basically says “Pokemon” in the name.... it’s just a regular quiz app. With no Pokémon. As far as I could tell in the first 10 minutes of play. Because the promise that you give, is a Pokemon quiz app. One would assume you mean ONLY Pokémon which is why it’s so confusing as to why you have to either work to get to Pokemon or there’s no Pokémon quizzes whatsoever.
